title: Eccovi il medico
subtitle: Don Alfonso, Ferrando, Guglielmo, Despina, Fiordiligi and Dorabella: Act 1 finale (No. 18), section 4, from Così fan tutte

passages.label: Eccovi il medico · Salvete, amabiles · Parla un linguaggio
Come comandano · Tanti linguaggi · Signor dottore
Saper bisognami · Preso han l'arsenico · Non vi affannate
Egli ha di un ferro · Questo è quel pezzo di calamita
Come si muovono · Tenete forte · Attorno guardano (to the end)

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 1 scene 16, No. 18 Finale, section 4 of 6

licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score: Despina's “so il turco e il vandalo” (the libretto has no “e”), “lo sveco” (a print slip for svevo, Swabian; the IPA and meaning are svevo's), Mesmerica, nell' Alemagna as two words, si celebre and fù, tenete sù, corraggio (IPA as coraggio), Dorabella's giu and Fiordiligi's giù, per se, and the officers' aside in brackets.

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 169–177, bars 292–428 of No. 18
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the No. 18 Finale (697 bars) read in fifteen page ranges, sung lines and piano each by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the zoomed page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by nine fresh proofreaders (three fixes on pages 148–154, the rest clean). The German singing translation is left out. All the singers of this section have a staff throughout, with rests where the print leaves a staff out; singers who do not sing in this section are left out. Cut from the one-file finale at bars 292–428: from the Allegro in 3/4 (Despina enters disguised as the doctor) to the bar of rest with the fermata before the Andante. Playback tempo ♩ = 137 from René Jacobs's recording (harmonia mundi), 3:00.
